title: Diretoria executiva de receita
description:
Confira a vaga para Diretoria executiva de receita em rio grande. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

O mercado de mídia out-of-home e soluções publicitárias passa por um momento de crescimento e consolidação. Com a expansão das operações e o aumento da complexidade comercial, a empresa busca fortalecer sua estrutura de vendas, ampliar a previsibilidade dos resultados e aprimorar o uso de dados na tomada de decisão. Nesse contexto, procuramos um Diretor Executivo de Receita (CRO) para liderar a estratégia comercial, estruturar processos, desenvolver a inteligência de vendas e apoiar o crescimento sustentável da organização. Como Diretor Executivo de Receita, sua principal missão será organizar a estratégia comercial da empresa, fortalecendo processos, modelos de precificação e indicadores de desempenho para tornar a operação mais previsível e escalável. Você será responsável por desenvolver a estrutura de vendas, acompanhar a evolução do funil comercial, ampliar as iniciativas de prospecção e fortalecer o relacionamento com parceiros estratégicos. Também terá papel importante na evolução da equipe, promovendo alinhamento entre as áreas comerciais e os objetivos de crescimento da companhia. Principais ResponsabilidadesDesenvolver o planejamento de receita, alinhando metas de crescimento às estratégias comerciais e indicadores de desempenho; Definir políticas de precificação e negociação, garantindo rentabilidade e consistência nas decisões comerciais. Estruturar indicadores e aprimorar o uso do CRM para acompanhar resultados, identificar oportunidades e apoiar a tomada de decisão; Implantar e desenvolver a operação de prospecção (SDR), criando processos que ampliem a geração de novas oportunidades de negócio; Coordenar o relacionamento comercial com parceiros estratégicos, promovendo alinhamento entre objetivos, processos e resultados; Liderar e desenvolver gestores e equipes comerciais, fortalecendo uma cultura orientada por desempenho, colaboração e desenvolvimento contínuo; Conduzir negociações estratégicas com grandes clientes e executivos de alto nível, contribuindo para a expansão dos negócios. RequisitosExperiência consolidada na liderança de áreas comerciais ou de receita, como CRO, Diretor Comercial ou VP de Vendas, preferencialmente nos setores de tecnologia, serviços ou mídia; Vivência na estruturação de processos comerciais, gestão de CRM, análise de indicadores e desenvolvimento de operações de prospecção (SDR); Experiência em ambientes de crescimento, expansão ou transformação organizacional, com capacidade para estruturar processos e liderar mudanças; Habilidade para atuar junto à alta liderança, conduzindo negociações estratégicas e apoiando decisões de negócio.

title: Customer success manager jr
description:
Confira a vaga para Customer success manager jr em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2 B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração. Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2 P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.Customer Success Manager Jr CLTEstamos em busca de um(a)Customer Success Manager (CSM) Low Touchpara atuar estrategicamente na gestão da carteira de clientes empresariais (B2 B), com foco em Onboarding, Adoção, Engajamento, Gestão de Riscos e Prevenção de Churn. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir que os clientes extraiam o máximo valor da solução, atuando como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) em sua jornada. Espera-se uma postura consultiva, com capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e identificar oportunidades de melhoria, atuando também como ponte entre cliente e áreas internas.Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio? Conduzir processos de onboarding estruturado, garantindo alinhamento de expectativas e aceleração do time-to-value. Estimular a adoção contínua da plataforma, identificando casos de uso e promovendo melhores práticas. Realizar análises de saúde da conta, antecipar riscos e elaborar planos de ação para mitigá-los. Atuar na prevenção de churn, com foco em retenção e expansão da base de clientes. Utilizar habilidades de análise de negócios para interpretar métricas, identificar padrões de comportamento e propor soluções orientadas por dados. Colaborar com áreas internas (Produto, Suporte, Vendas) para garantir a voz do cliente e promover melhorias.Será bacana se você tiver: Experiência em processos, sistemas e operações de compras; Experiência com sistema e-Procurement será um diferencial; Habilidades em lidar com clientes e equipe interna; Conhecimento em Excel, Power Point; Alta capacidade analítica; Boa comunicação; Organização e autonomia para lidar com diferentes tarefas e prioridades diárias; Graduação em áreas relacionadas a tecnologia; Conhecimentos básicos sobre Customer Success será um diferencial; Conhecimento em SQL para consultas será um diferencial;

Ability to assess functional gaps and defineresolution approaches withinthe boundaries of SAP Cloud ERP's standard architecture (configuration, key-user adaptations, or SAP BTP extensions). - Proven ability to lead, mentor, and coordinate teamsof functional consultants across multiple workstreams. - Advanced proficiency in English Language (C1 or C2) to maintain businesslevel conversations. - Excellent workshopfacilitation, requirements gathering, and solution documentation skills. - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills,including the abilityto engage confidently with customer process owners and executive audiences. - Based in São Paulo, Brazil | Full-time | Extensive regional travel Position Summary AV Flexologic B. V. is seeking a Field Service Engineer to join its global Service & Support division, based in São Paulo, Brazil. This role provides on-site installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair services for AV Flexologic equipment at customer sites across Brazil, Argentina, Chile, and Central America. The successful candidate will work closely with the Service & Support coordination team (Alphen aan den Rijn, Netherlands) and the Monterrey and Bangkok offices to ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery across the region.Engagement structure This role is structured as an independent contractor engagement: the engineer will operate through their own Brazilian legal entity (CNPJ / "PJ" — pessoa jurídica) and issue a monthly invoice (nota fiscal) to AV Flexologic for services rendered, rather than being hired as a CLT employee.Key Responsibilities Perform installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and repair of AV Flexologic equipment at customer sites. Diagnose and resolve technical issues in the field, escalating to engineering or product specialists as needed. Travel regularly within the São Paulo area and across Brazil, as well as to Argentina, Chile, and Central America, for scheduled and emergency service visits. Provide clear, timely reporting on service visits, parts usage, and customer feedback to the Service & Support coordination team. Maintain professional communication with customers, distributors, and internal stakeholders in Portuguese, Spanish, and English. Support training of local customer technicians where applicable. Maintain assigned company equipment (vehicle, tools, laptop, phone) in good working order.Travel Requirements This is a field-based, travel-intensive role. Expected travel coverage includes: São Paulo metropolitan area and state (base region, most frequent travel) Other regions of Brazil, as service demand requires Argentina and Chile Central America ("Middle America") Travel frequency will vary by season and customer install base; candidates should expect travel for a significant portion of working time, including multi-day international trips. A valid passport and the ability to obtain visas/work authorizations for the above countries is required.Candidate Requirements Technical degree or vocational qualification in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics, or industrial engineering (or equivalent hands-on field service experience). Prior experience in field service, industrial equipment maintenance, or a similar customer-facing technical role. Fluent Portuguese (native/near-native) and working proficiency in English required; Spanish strongly preferred given Argentina/Chile/Central America coverage. Valid driver's license; comfortable with frequent independent travel. Strong troubleshooting mindset, customer service orientation, and ability to work autonomously in the field.Service Availability & Extra HoursExpected availability Equivalent to 40 hours per weekExtra hours beyond scope Additional hours may be billed as an extra line item on the monthly invoice, or offset with reduced availability in a following period, as agreed between the parties. Downtime & Public HolidaysAgreed annual downtime 20–25 business days per year with no invoice reduction, by mutual agreement (contractual, not statutory)National public holidays 9 fixed federal holidays, plus movable holidays (see list below) — no service expected, no invoice reductionBrazilian national (federal) holidays January 1 – New Year's Day April 21 – Tiradentes Day May 1 – Labour Day September 7 – Independence Day October 12 – Our Lady of Aparecida (Patron Saint of Brazil) November 2 – All Souls' Day November 15 – Republic Proclamation Day November 20 – National Black Consciousness Day (federal holiday since 2024) December 25 – Christmas Day In addition, Good Friday and Corpus Christi are movable, date-dependent observances, and Carnival (February/March) is technically an optional "ponto facultativo" day rather than a mandatory holiday — in practice, it is observed by the vast majority of Brazilian employers. State and municipal holidays (e.g., São Paulo city/state-specific dates) may add further non-working days depending on exact work location. On request holidays can be traded for work days in mutual agreement.Compensation (Monthly Invoice)Monthly invoice amount (indicative) Based on experience levelTravel expenses Covered by AV Flexologic for company travel.Equipment Provided Company credit card for business/travel expenses Company mobile phone Company laptop Company vehicle — to be assessed based on actual travel patterns and territory size; if not provided, a vehicle/mileage allowance will apply for local travel

- Excel avançado; diferencial para Python, VBA ou SQL aplicados a análise de risco; - Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão/risco (ex: Bloomberg, Comdinheiro, sistemas de administradoras como BTG, Fides, etc.) é um diferencial; description:

title: Senior revenue accountant - us gaap & process automation
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior revenue accountant - us gaap & process automation em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Accounting Data Analyst — RevenueAs one of the top mobility companies in the world, we have been redefining the industry with innovative mobile technologies since 2013, driving us toward becoming a super app. Join us in our mission to combat global injustice.We are looking for an experienced accounting professional with strong technical and data skills to join our global Accounting team. In this role, you'll prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, and revenue data packages that keep our books accurate, auditable, and US GAAP compliant — while writing the SQL and building the automation that makes those processes scalable as we prepare for public company readiness. You'll report to a US-based Revenue Accounting leader (Eastern Time) and partner daily with accounting, data, and payment reconciliation colleagues across the globe. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable posting a journal entry in an ERP and querying a data warehouse — and who gets energized by fixing broken processes, not just running them.What You'll Do Prepare complete, review-ready journal entries across revenue, accounts receivable, payment provider settlements, chargebacks/refunds, taxes, and intercompany — with full supporting detail for ERP posting Prepare account reconciliations, flux analyses, and supporting schedules for monthly, quarterly, and annual close Write and maintain SQL queries against our data warehouse to extract and validate the data behind accruals and ASC 606 revenue recognition Support payment service provider (PSP) reconciliations — validating settlement, refund, chargeback, and fee data across geographies and currencies, and flagging discrepancies Document processes end-to-end and support SOX readiness, responding to internal and external audit requests as the preparer with full traceability from source to output Identify manual, error-prone steps and automate them — including with AI-enabled tooling — partnering with Data Engineering, IT, and Fin Tech teamsWhat We're Looking For ~8 years of progressive accounting experience, including hands-on journal entry preparation and month-end close ownership Accounting degree with CRC or equivalent professional qualification (CPA-equivalent) Solid working knowledge of US GAAP; hands-on ASC 606 revenue recognition experience is a major plus Strong SQL skills — able to write and adapt queries against large-scale data warehouses (Big Query or similar) Proficiency with an ERP system (Net Suite, SAP, Oracle or similar): chart of accounts, journal entry posting, validation, and drill-down analysis Experience supporting internal or external audits; exposure to SOX controls and documentation Fluent English — this role works daily with a US-based team during Eastern Time hoursNice to Have Big 4 or large multinational (Fortune 500-scale) background; IPO or public company readiness experience Industry experience with complex, high-volume revenue models (tech/marketplace, retail, media, manufacturing) Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) and scripting for automationWho Thrives Here Someone gritty and curious who gets into the weeds, asks questions, and comes with proposed solutions. We're moving fast toward a bigger goal: priorities pivot, hours can stretch during peak periods, and feedback is direct. If you like ambiguity, ownership, and building processes that didn't exist yesterday, you'll fit right in!What we offer Competitive compensation package Comprehensive medical insurance coverage. Meal allowance Dental Insurance Hybrid setting Opportunity for advancement and upward mobility within the organization, allowing for increased levels of responsibility and growth within the company

Estabelecer uma visão clara de risco versus retorno, conectando aprovação de crédito, precificação, inadimplência, perdas esperadas, rentabilidade e crescimento. Criar alertas antecipados e rotinas de revisão para deterioração de carteira, exceções, renegociações e concentração de risco Requisitos e qualificaçõesExperiência sólida em risco de crédito, preferencialmente em fintech, banco, financeira, IP, adquirente ou negócio de crédito com uso intensivo de dados. Forte capacidade de análise de balanços, demonstrações financeiras, fluxo de caixa, exposição, garantias e capacidade de pagamento. description:

Role DescriptionThe Global Sales Support Specialist (GSS) is a critical driver of revenue within the Sales Finance organization, empowering the Field Sales Team with expert support in complex quoting, order processing, and product configuration. As a subject matter expert, the GSS ensures seamless deal execution while collaborating across functions to streamline processes and maximize efficiency.This fast-paced role demands a proactive, highly organized individual who thrives under pressure. The GSS directly engages with internal sales and business operations teams to optimize sales execution, enable new product introductions, and keep quoting operations running smoothly and effectively. Location - Sao Paulo - HYBRID/ 3 days in office or 70% in office throughout the month Duration - 12 monthsYour Impact This position calls for someone who possesses good communication skills, sense of ownership, proactiveness and maturity working with confidential and sensitive information. This person is a self-starter, flexible, has a high level of integrity and quick to action in a fast-paced, team-oriented, collaborative environment.Sales Support Excellence: Support the Field Sales Team with quoting complex deals, responding to order inquiries, and providing guidance on product configurations in SFDC CPQ. Facilitate training on quote-to-order processes, including SFDC quoting sessions, ensuring that our Sales team members are equipped with the knowledge needed to drive sales success. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams including Deal Review, Pricing, Product, Sales Operations, and IT to ensure the smooth implementation of business policies, scalable quoting processes, and GTM offerings in SFDC CPQ. Process Documentation & Best Practices: Collaborate with the documentation team to ensure that our quoting decks are accurate, well-structured, and aligned to drive sales success. Act as a Subject Matter Expert in new product introductions, helping to design and refine quoting best practices for both new and existing products, ensuring clarity and consistency across all enablement materials. System & Process Improvement: Serve as a key partner in driving business requirements for system enhancements in SFDC CPQ, actively participating in the testing and UAT process to ensure new functionalities align with business needs. Identify and escalate system gaps or opportunities for process improvements, collaborating to streamline workflows and eliminate inefficiencies. GTM Readiness & Operational Coordination: Ensure the operational readiness of new GTM offers by collaborating with cross-functional teams to enable seamless execution of new product offerings. Build strong relationships with internal teams (Product, Sales, Legal, IT, etc.) to ensure alignment and smooth quoting processes. Project Management & Communication: Work with business partners to define objectives, set timelines, and track the status of quoting changes. Communicate milestones, dependencies, and project status updates to key stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success. Prioritization & Execution: Manage a shared mailbox for Global Sales Support activities, prioritizing requests based on revenue impact, customer relationship considerations, and timing requirements to meet deadlines.Your ExperienceExperience: 5+ years of experience in Sales Support, Sales Operations, Finance, or Contract Management, preferably in a Saa S or subscription-based business. Proven experience with Pricing/Quoting processes and an understanding of GTM strategies. Technical Proficiency: Strong experience with Salesforce (SFDC CPQ) and proficiency with Google Suite (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, etc.) is essential. A tech-savvy mindset and ability to navigate complex systems to enhance quoting processes. Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, internal teams, and International stakeholders. Ability to balance individual tasks while supporting team priorities in a dynamic environment. Organizational & Analytical Skills: Extremely detail-oriented with a high level of organization and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze processes and suggest improvements. Additional Requirements: Ability to work extended hours as needed, particularly around month-end or quarter-end workloads. Flexibility to work alternate shifts to accommodate global requests and ensure timely support. Language:Fluent English, Spanish and Portuguese.Information about Palo Alto Networks At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish — but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

description:

Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado. Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes. Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência. Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos. Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras. Planejar e acompanhar a execução das atividades de campo, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e metas do projeto. Acompanhar a instalação de tubulações, suportes, válvulas, acessórios e equipamentos associados aos sistemas de gás. Garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos de Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SSMA/QSMS), promovendo uma cultura de trabalho seguro. Coordenar a interface entre as equipes de engenharia, planejamento, inspeção, segurança, operação e empresas contratadas. Controlar o avanço físico das obras, elaborar relatórios técnicos e registrar ocorrências relevantes. Validar medições dos serviços executados pelas empresas terceirizadas, quando aplicável. Apoiar a resolução de problemas técnicos durante a execução das atividades, buscando soluções que minimizem impactos no cronograma. Assegurar a correta utilização de materiais, equipamentos e recursos disponibilizados para a obra. Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes, fornecedores e empresas contratadas, apresentando o status das atividades e os principais indicadores. Qualificações Cursos técnicos em Mecânica, Tubulação Industrial ou áreas correlatas. Experiência em coordenação e fiscalização de empresas terceirizadas de montagem industrial. Vivência em projetos de redes de distribuição de gás, gasodutos, city gates ou plantas industriais. Conhecimento em leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos, P&ID, isométricos e fluxogramas. Conhecimento das normas ASME B31.3, ASME B31.8, API 1104, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35 e demais normas aplicáveis ao setor. Experiência com testes hidrostáticos, pneumáticos, testes de estanqueidade e atividades de comissionamento. Conhecimento em planejamento e controle de obras, gestão de cronogramas Habilidade em liderança, negociação, tomada de decisão, resolução de conflitos e gestão de equipes terceirizadas. Domínio do Pacote Office e familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de manutenção, obras ou ERP será considerado um diferencial. CNH categoria B e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e acompanhamento de obras em campo. Será visto como um diferencial: Experiência no setor de gás natural, petróleo, energia ou indústria de processos. Certificações em gestão de projetos, inspeção de tubulação ou soldagem. description:

They partner closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Carrier Management to develop aligned bid strategies and deliver winning tender responses. They build strong relationships with carriers, evaluate market conditions, and lead cross‑functional teams through complex RFQs, RFPs, and tender cycles. They develop regional pricing frameworks, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement in pricing accuracy, tender quality, and commercial outcomes. They also provide strategic insights based on post‑tender evaluations, helping refine future pursuits and improve long‑term profitability.Responsibilities Oversee and manage the complete pricing and tender lifecycle, including analysis of wins/losses, pipeline performance, and regional pricing positions. Develop and execute clear bid strategies in collaboration with sales, technical teams, and cross‑functional stakeholders, defining win themes, timelines, and resource needs. Lead and motivate cross‑functional bid teams, assigning responsibilities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely, high‑quality tender submissions. Conduct comprehensive reviews of RFPs, RFQs, and customer requirements to identify risks, operational considerations, and solution opportunities. Manage regional relationships with air, ocean, and ground carriers, securing competitive rates and optimizing procurement strategies. Develop regional pricing frameworks across multimodal services (ground, intermodal, air, ocean, contract logistics, etc.). Ensure pricing outputs support profitable growth, align with target margins, and reinforce customer value propositions. Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers, service capabilities, network constraints, and profitability levers. Drive pricing strategy in alignment with Regional Sales leadership, ensuring consistency and commercial competitiveness. Maintain visibility of regional pricing and tender pipeline performance, including turnaround time, quality metrics, and commercial outcomes. Conduct post‑tender and post‑award reviews to identify lessons learned and implement continuous improvement best practices. Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, market shifts, and procurement practices to guide strategic pricing decisions. Provide training, coaching, and best‑practice guidance to regional sales and support teams on pricing tools and tender processes. Support digital pricing initiatives, workflow standardization, and process optimization across regional teams. All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Supply Chain, Administration, Foreign Trade, Project Management) from an accredited college or university required. Certification/Licensure: Industry certifications such as CILT, CSCMP, APICS, FIATA, etc. preferred but not required. Languages: English (Advanced) and Native Spanish (Advanced). 3+ years of experience in pricing, tender management, and/or air/ocean freight forwarding. Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender documentation, bid structures, and commercial/legal frameworks. Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely. Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities. Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information. Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.). Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on‑site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

description:

The Portfolio Management area plays a lead role in implementing Greystar's investment strategies, programs, policies, and initiatives related to investment management and oversight of funds, joint ventures and separate accounts. This role collaborates with different business areas on the development and implementation of business plans and practices to achieve the financial, investment, and operating goals of a portfolio. The Portfolio Management area also oversees all internal and external reporting of ventures, life-of-fund models, strategy papers, the creation, structuring, and legal documentation of entities, strategy compliance of investment opportunities, etc. Tasks of the Portfolio Management area in greater detail: Monitor and oversee individual investment or portfolio performance in relation to asset and portfolio objectives in Brazil and Chile, critically evaluating existing real estate operations and business plan execution to identify new strategies to drive NOI and maximize returns across the portfolio. Provide detailed reports, market updates for Brazil and Chile, and financial analysis on the performance of the portfolios, making recommendations for strategies to maximize value. Perform portfolio return and valuation analysis and review and prepare both internal and external reporting for assigned ventures Participate in routine market review discussions in Brazil and Chile to examine the overall operational and financial results for the owned asset portfolio, present and justify business plans, make strategy recommendations, and complete portfolio return and valuation analysis. Actively participate in major capitalization initiatives, acquisitions and dispositions. Work closely with the Finance and Investment teams to actively manage debt obligations and execute financings / refinancings for each investment. Maintain and implement detailed knowledge of various partnership agreements and venture structures, ensuring appropriate governance is maintained. Bring ownership's perspective to managing each asset. Provide insights on key activities at properties and important decisions needed to drive performance. Work with internal teams to set performance objectives for each investment and asses potential exit strategies. Communicate to investors on the overall Venture's objectives and projected returns. In this role the potential candidate would do things like: Develop and maintain robust fund models that are the basis for decision-making for in-place funds and new potential funds, as well as the basis for investor and internal recurring reporting requirements. Provide the financial analysis supporting potential acquisitions and disposition, including whether the transaction is supportive of the vehicle's strategic rationale and the near- and long-term financial impact of transactions. Work on a collaborative basis to monitor and evaluate existing investments in support of the Venture's strategic objectives. Review annual business plans for each asset and the overall portfolio. Support the monthly and quarterly reporting process for the Fund's assets. Support in the annual / semi-annual appraisal process of the Fund's assets, assisting with the third-party appraisers. Assist Brazil and Chile investments team in structuring the thesis for new funds or club deals Support the portfolio management team in the assessment of the different alternatives of exits in Chile and Brazil to potentialize the return for the investors Develop and maintain a market intel database for main metrics related to the multifamily business and relevant competitors Knowledge & Qualifications: Bachelor's degree required in engineering, finance, economics or other relevant major. Organization skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Strong communication, Microsoft Excel, Power Point and Word skills. Power BI skills are not mandatory but will be considered a valuable addition to the candidate's qualifications English language proficiency in writing and speaking. Proficiency in Spanish is not a requirement but will be considered an asset for the potential candidate Experience & Skills: A demonstrable passion for real estate and keen interest in business strategy. Strong qualitative analytical skills; having the ability to research, analyse and present complex financial data. Interested in financial modelling, valuations, and financial analysis. Strong organizational, time-management, and project management skills in order to effectively track, report, and manage multiple projects and priorities where meeting deadlines is critical.

Our broad portfolio spans cellular modules (5 G, LTE, LPWA), GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and satellite communication modules, antennas, and Io T connectivity services — combined with outstanding support and services that shorten our customers' time-to-market.With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of Io T innovators worldwide. Together with ecosystem affiliates such as Acceleronix (Io T platform and Connectivity-as-a-Service), Quectel enables end-to-end solutions from module to cloud.Life at Quectel LATAM At Quectel LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in Io T modules. Asset Tracking & Logistics —Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility. Smart Agriculture —Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking. Connected Mobility & Automotive —Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility. Smart Home & Consumer Io T —Connected appliances, energy management, security.Why Quectel LATAM? Career Growth & Development —Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Represent rights holders in pre-litigation, civil litigation, and criminal IP proceedings; Coordinate and participate in search and seizure operations (raids) and enforcement actions with local authorities (Police, Customs, Public Prosecutor's Office, regulatory agencies, etc.); Draft and file powers of attorney, affidavits, criminal complaints, petitions, and litigation documents; Build and maintain strong relationships with law enforcement agencies, courts, investigators, and service providers; Recover monetary compensation through settlements or court decisions; Support the company's legal and business operations in Brazil (contracts, compliance, office setup, banking, and corporate matters, as needed).What we expect from you:Law degree and admission to the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB); Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Intellectual Property (either in-house or at a law firm); Proven experience with IP enforcement, including: Civil litigation; Criminal IP matters, including search and seizure actions, criminal complaints, anti-counterfeiting investigations, and interactions with police and prosecutors; Experience coordinating enforcement actions with public authorities; Strong legal drafting, negotiation, and communication skills; Fluent Portuguese and professional English (written and spoken); Highly organized, proactive, and able to work independently in a global environment; Must reside in São Paulo (city or metropolitan area) due to the need for in-person attendance at courts, hearings, and enforcement operations.What We Offer:Work with top-tier global clients and international teams; Competitive salary; Opportunity to lead and shape Brand Monitor's legal operations in Brazil; Remote-first work environment with flexibility; Meaningful impact in the global fight against counterfeiting and intellectual property violations; Career growth within a fast-growing international legal-tech company.

Em um cenário de alta demanda por produtos biológicos mais robustos, seguros e escaláveis, a empresa busca fortalecer sua capacidade de PD&I em vacinas veterinárias. O projeto tem como foco o desenvolvimento de vacinas vivas atenuadas multivalentes para bovinos, contemplando desde as etapas laboratoriais de cultivo celular e viral, purificação, formulação e liofilização até a validação pré-clínica e clínica dos produtos. Se você tem formação em Farmácia, Engenharia Química, Biotecnologia, Engenharia de Bioprocessos, Engenharia Bioquímica ou áreas correlatas, e interesse em atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos biológicos para saúde animal, essa oportunidade é para você. Buscamos um perfil técnico, analítico e inovador, com conhecimento em formulação, estabilidade, purificação, UF/DF e integração de etapas produtivas, preparado para contribuir com soluções de alto impacto para a indústria veterinária. Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado completo em : Farmácia, Engenharia Química, Biotecnologia, Engenharia de Bioprocessos, Biotecnologia, Engenharia Bioquímica e áreas afins Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos. Projeto: Desenvolvimento de vacinas vivas atenuadas multivalentes para prevenção de doenças respiratórias e reprodutivas em bovinos. Principais Atividades: Desenvolvimento de vacinas para a saúde animal, participando de um projeto estratégico de alto impacto. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem: Conduzir o desenvolvimento de vacinas multivalentes, desde as etapas laboratoriais até a preparação para escala industrial. Planejar e executar estudos experimentais avançados, com foco na otimização e controle de processos (Qb D). Desenvolver e aprimorar etapas críticas do processo, com destaque para liofilização, garantindo estabilidade e viabilidade do produto. Atuar no escalonamento de bioprocessos, assegurando reprodutibilidade, robustez e desempenho em ambiente industrial. Aplicar e desenvolver métodos analíticos (PCR, titulação viral, ensaios biológicos) para garantir a qualidade e confiabilidade dos resultados. Integrar diferentes etapas produtivas (cultivo celular, replicação viral, purificação, formulação e liofilização) de forma consistente e eficiente. Analisar dados experimentais utilizando ferramentas estatísticas e transformar resultados em insights técnicos. Elaborar relatórios técnicos para suporte à tomada de decisão e atividades regulatórias. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares em um ambiente de inovação aplicada. Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos Experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos biológicos, vacinas ou bioprocessos. Conhecimento prático em cultivo celular e/ou replicação viral. Experiência com técnicas analíticas, como PCR, titulação viral ou ensaios biológicos. Vivência em planejamento experimental e análise de dados científicos. Capacidade de comunicação técnica e elaboração de relatórios consistentes. Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais Liofilização aplicada a produtos biológicos. Formulação e estudos de estabilidade de vacinas ou biofármacos. Escalonamento de processos (scale-up) e transferência de tecnologia para ambiente industrial. Técnicas de purificação, como ultrafiltração e diafiltração tangencial (UF/DF). Aplicação de Quality by Design (Qb D) no desenvolvimento de processos. Definição e controle de parâmetros críticos (CPPs) e atributos de qualidade (CQAs). Validação analítica e estudos de biocomparabilidade. Uso de ferramentas estatísticas avançadas (ex.: Design of Experiments – Do E). Experiência com requisitos regulatórios e geração de documentação técnica Perfil colaborativo, com capacidade de atuação em times multidisciplinares e projetos complexos. Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial Formato de trabalho : Presencial / Campo Largo/PR Soft Skills : Ética e responsabilidade, Autonomia, Pensamento crítico, Organização, Trabalho em equipe e Criatividade.

title: Qc - manager
description:

Oversee all analytical testing activities to ensure compliance with GMP, GLP, ANVISA RDC, and other applicable regulatory requirements, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and traceability throughout all operations, maintaining the laboratory in a state of inspection readiness. Ensure robust method transfer processes are in place and executed effectively, collaborating closely with R&D, manufacturing, and third-party contractors. Drive the timely release of analytical results within schedules while maintaining stringent quality standards. Manage the acquisition, qualification, calibration, and maintenance of all QC laboratory equipment and instrumentation. Oversee the entire process for chemicals, reagents, and reference standards management, from procurement to disposal, ensuring supply chain integrity and compliance. Establish and maintain robust quality systems within QC, including OOS/Deviation management, CAPA effectiveness, change control, and risk management. Provide strategic direction for complex method troubleshooting, OOS investigations and other quality related process. Forecast and manage the departmental budget, including staffing, equipment, consumables, and external services. Develop and implement the strategic vision and operational plans for the QC department, aligning with the company overall business objectives and quality goals. Actively participate in internal and external regulatory audits (e.g., ANVISA, client audits), providing expert responses and presenting laboratory data and processes. Act as a primary point of contact and subject matter expert for all QC-related discussions during internal and external audits. Lead the preparation and response to audit findings, ensuring timely and effective CAPA implementation and closure. Stay abreast of new and evolving pharmaceutical regulations and industry best practices, ensuring the QC department remains fully compliant. Plano de Carreira O desenvolvimento começa já na formação e evolui de forma estruturada, com avaliações em cada etapa e oportunidades de crescimento até posições de maior senioridade.
